narrative: GitWeave now owns its resource namespace via GW_RESOURCE_PREFIX. Before this change, gw plan, apply and reset all hard-required FORGE_RESOURCE_PREFIX — a forge test-isolation variable with no place in production — so operators could not run the apply path without forge's env. Now GW_RESOURCE_PREFIX is the ownership gate; FORGE_RESOURCE_PREFIX optionally narrows scope in forge CI runs. The Apply workflow CI no longer calls the broken apply-overlays.py stub, the apply job carries GW_RESOURCE_PREFIX from secrets, and the full offline test suite exits zero.

checkpoints.caption: gw plan succeeds with GW_RESOURCE_PREFIX alone
gw apply scopes resources by GW_RESOURCE_PREFIX
